messages:
Maya (SE): kicking off a short POC with NimbusRetail. they want streaming + function calls + compact JSON outputs. need quick runbook, auth/pricing notes, and EU residency confirmation.
Sam K (Presales): nice. quick questions: expected concurrent streams and peak qps? will they call an internal inventory tool?
Maya (SE): plan: 40 concurrent streams, peak ~100 qps, prompt ~100-200 tokens. yes, demo will call inventory.update and expect structured item JSON back.
Ben R (AE): pricing: hosted per-token for POC; option for short Dedicated trial if they want stable latency. estimate ~8-12M tokens over 2 weeks. I'll model numbers if you give exact token estimate.
Leah P (Security): security checklist: SAML SSO required, customer-managed KMS, SOC2 evidence requested, and EU data residency. send their questionnaire.
Maya (SE): they need EU-only. can we meet that with hosted+VPC peering or do we need Dedicated/Private?
deploy-bot: Dedicated availability: eu-west capacity limited; reserve lead time 7-14 days. ephemeral/demo slices easier.
Sam K (Presales): short answer: hosted + customer KMS + VPC peering can keep inference in EU, but platform control-plane logs default to US unless EU logging add-on enabled. Leah to confirm tradeoffs.
Leah P (Security): confirm: inference requests can remain in EU with our EU region. control plane logs require EU logging add-on or Dedicated/Private to guarantee all telemetry stays in EU. DPA + SCCs required.
procurement-bot: DPA and SCCs URL: https://redwood.internal/docs/legal/dpa_and_sccs.pdf ; EU logging add-on: https://redwood.internal/pricing/eu-logging
Maya (SE): technical ask: can someone paste a short Go streaming + function-call snippet we can drop into their demo app? keep it minimal.
Sam K (Presales): short sanitized snippet below:
Sam K (Presales): ```go
// minimal streaming + functioncall example
client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
stream := client.Stream(ctx, redwood.StreamRequest{Model: "gpt-stream-1", Prompt: "Update inventory #1234", Tools: []redwood.Tool{{Name: "inventory.update", Schema: `{"id":"string","qty":"int"}`}}})
for m := range stream.Messages() {
  if m.Type == redwood.MsgFunctionCall {
    // call inventory service and reply
    result := callInventoryService(m.FunctionCall.Payload)
    stream.SendFunctionResponse(m.FunctionCall.Name, result)
  }
  if m.Type == redwood.MsgOutput {
    fmt.Println("Structured output:", string(m.Data))
  }
}
```
Ben R (AE): I'll prepare three pricing options (hosted POC, 30d reserved trial, small Dedicated commit) and share numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (SE): Nimbus will send an infosec questionnaire. who owns vendor form?
Leah P (Security): send it to me + procurement. I'll fill SOC2/KMS/VPC items and include redacted pen-test summary if requested.
Maya (SE): blockers: 1) EU residency confirmation 2) sanitized demo dataset 3) SAML test account 4) provisional pricing for credits
Sam K (Presales): actions: Ben -> pricing by EOD; Leah -> EU logging & DPA caveats; Maya -> sanitized data + SAML test account by Tue; I'll draft a 30-min demo script with the Go snippet. :thumbsup:
Ben R (AE): on it, will post draft pricing in-thread.
Leah P (Security): posting DPA caveats and EU logging checklist by EOD.
Maya (SE): propose Wed 10:00 UTC for tech run-through with Nimbus devs. Ben confirm?
Ben R (AE): Wed 10:00 UTC good for me.
deploy-bot: Reminder: request Dedicated canary here with GPU type and start/end dates if you need a reserved demo pool. ETA 7-14 days.
Maya (SE): last Q: recommended model/config to keep 95th <200ms for structured outputs?
Sam K (Presales): recommend gpt-stream-1, dynamic batching off for demo; if latency high, try smaller low-latency variant or enable prefix KV caching. run quick canary to verify.
Maya (SE): thanks everyone 44c I'll post invite and follow up with sanitized data.
